description_en: Modifies an automatic materialized view recommendation task
description_zh: 修改物化视图自动推荐任务
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-materialized-view-recommend --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-uf6o00000 --task-name task_n1 --scheduling-policy weekly --scheduling-day Monday_Wednesday --specified-time 10:00:00 --scan-queries-range 3 --description task_desc --slow-query-threshold 2 --min-rewrite-query-pattern 5 --min-rewrite-query-count 3 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyMaterializedViewRecommend

parameters.description_en:
The recommendation policy. Valid values: 
- daliy: scheduled on a daily basis.
- weekly: scheduled on a weekly basis.

- daliy：按日调度。
-  weekly：按周调度。
